notes.title: Minor Game Update
notes.notes:
v1.1.2490:
	- overall performances improvements
	- optimized monster path finding in hack n slash level
	- streaming of some big levels
	- upgraded to FP 11.6/AIR 3.8
	- optimized light assignement to reduce shader updates in hack level
	- changed algorithm for point lights in hack level (use normals + multiply)
	- better looking hero ambient lighting in hack level
	- use WinXP dinput8.dll (should prevent some pad.exe crashes on XP)
	- allow heal during bombs quest
	- heal hero when kaeris leave in aogai
	- allow talking to merchant while airship is near
	- fix airship recovery in sacred grove
	- fix hero-in-a-rock when going back to start level
	- few typos
